text:
rachael: Mystery snack alert 81: Who nabbed the last brownie from the kitchen stash? It had a tiny fork in it.
omar: Not me. I confess to being a cookie person. Brownies are sacred, though. :crying_cat_face:
lee: I saw someone with chocolate on their chin around 10:12. No names.
rachael: Note to self: put 'Do not eat' sticky note AND tiny surveillance (aka a plant).
ops-bot: FYI: Kitchen camera footage not available. Suggested deterrent: label snacks with names or implement Snack Registry (manual).
omar: Snack Registry sounds official. I'll sign up as Snack Marshal.
lee: Proposal: all brownies get a serial number and tiny sticker. Also brownie forgiveness policy for the hungry.
rachael: Sticker plan accepted. Also whoever is Snack Marshal brings next batch.
omar: Deal. I'll bake and innocently leave crumbs as evidence. :wink:
rachael: Thread end 85: brownie diplomacy prevails.
